# An Unexpected Phone Call: direction notes

(A synthetic stand-in, written for the tests in the layout the plan describes: the real bible was not on the machine
that built plan/2026-11-05d. It holds only the two direction sections; the story is in tests/fixtures/prose.)

## Cinematic Direction

Keep the camera at eye level and let a phone call play in one held two-shot where it can.
The father is never shown: his side of the call is heard only.
Episode 2 is shot entirely in the rain.

## Sound & Music Direction

Ambient street sound under every call, never a score. No music until Anudi decides to go home.
Anudi's ringtone is the only recurring sound cue.

## Characters

ANUDI, 25, elegant. Wears a green cotton sari and a thin silver chain.
